root:
Usage: nocap [options] [command]

your agent says it's done. nocap checks.

Options:
  -V, --version                       output the version number
  -h, --help                          display help for command

Commands:
  check [options]                     verify an agent's summary against the repo
                                      in the current directory
  demo [options] [scenario]           build a fixture scenario in .cache and
                                      verify it with live output
  loop [options]                      closed repair loop: check, hand the repair
                                      packet to your agent, re-check
  hook <agent>                        agent hook entrypoint (stdin JSON).
                                      Currently: claude (Stop hook)
  init [options] [agent]              wire nocap into your agents: `init --all`
                                      detects them all; `init claude` installs
                                      only the Claude Code hook
  mcp                                 start the MCP stdio server (verify_claims,
                                      get_repair, bitecheck, check_scope, ...)
  bitecheck [options] <testFiles...>  prove specific tests bite: they must fail
                                      without the source change
  chain [chainId]                     print the proof-chain timeline (default:
                                      the latest chain)
  handoff [options]                   what the next agent can trust, must not
                                      rely on, and what is stale (from the
                                      ledger)
  scorecard                           per agent+model accuracy from local
                                      receipts
  repair [options] [receiptFile]      print repair instructions from the last
                                      (or a given) receipt
  publish [options] <receiptFile>     upload an existing receipt
  help [command]                      display help for command

commands.check:
Usage: nocap check [options]

verify an agent's summary against the repo in the current directory

Options:
  --summary <file|->           summary file, or - for stdin (default: stdin when
                               piped)
  --base <ref>                 base ref
  --head <ref>                 head ref (default: working-tree snapshot if
                               dirty, else HEAD)
  --agent <name>               agent name for the receipt
  --no-exec                    static checks only: never run tests or commands
  --offline                    never call an LLM
  --scope <concept=glob,glob>  map a concept to globs (repeatable) (default: [])
  --test-cmd <cmd>             custom test command with {files} and {out}
  --test-format <fmt>          jest|junit (with --test-cmd)
  --json                       print the receipt as JSON
  --md                         print the receipt as markdown
  --out <file>                 also write the rendered output to a file
  --publish                    upload the receipt to NOCAP_API_URL
  --no-hunks                   omit diff hunks when publishing
  --strict                     exit 3 when the result is MIXED
  --repair                     print repair instructions for contradicted claims
  --actor <agent>              acting agent
  --model <id>                 model id of the acting agent
  --role <name>                role of the acting agent
  --verbose                    narrate each step
  --chain <id|auto|new>        continue (or start) a proof chain across attempts
  --since-last                 judge only the delta since the previous receipt
                               (per-agent attribution)
  --scope-role <role=globs>    declare another role's scope (repeatable);
                               touching it raises cross_agent_overlap (default:
                               [])
  -h, --help                   display help for command
commands.demo:
Usage: nocap demo [options] [scenario]

build a fixture scenario in .cache and verify it with live output

Options:
  --no-exec   static checks only
  -h, --help  display help for command
commands.loop:
Usage: nocap loop [options]

closed repair loop: check, hand the repair packet to your agent, re-check

Options:
  --agent-cmd <cmd>        agent command; {repair_file} is replaced by the
                           repair packet path
  --summary <file|->       initial summary (default: stdin when piped)
  --summary-from <source>  where the agent's next summary comes from: stdout |
                           file:<path> (default: "stdout")
  --max <n>                maximum attempts (default: "3")
  --no-exec                static checks only
  --agent <name>           agent name for the receipts
  --base <ref>             base ref
  --verbose                narrate each step
  -h, --help               display help for command

wire nocap into your agents: `init --all` detects them all; `init claude`

  --write     apply the changes (default is a dry run)
  --user      allow writing user-level config (needed for Codex)
